summary: MPCA-133 Phase 6 Central Match-Official Assignment. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass (rate card, assign MPCA OK, assign Division/District 403 with correct message, bad role 400, missing official 404, list, summary math, patch/delete MPCA + persona RBAC). Frontend: MPCA panel fully functional (rate card, assign form, days editor, remove, summary with 'Paid by MPCA'). Division & District personas: assign form correctly hidden and info line shown. Fixed one CRITICAL blocker bug during testing (default import from @/lib/api).

ui_bugs.issue: URL query ?tab=officials does not auto-activate the Match Officials tab on initial load for Division persona (defaults to Budgets tab). Works fine for MPCA persona. Panel reachable via tab click. Likely: division-secretary's default tab logic overrides ?tab= param.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Fix tab query-param handling in TournamentFinanceConsole for non-MPCA personas so /tournaments/{tid}/finance?tab=officials lands directly on the Match Officials tab (currently only works for MPCA).
critical_code_review_comments: MatchOfficialsPanel.jsx was using `import api from '@/lib/api'` but @/lib/api has NO default export — only named `api`. This blocked the entire finance console from compiling (webpack overlay covered the whole app). Fixed by changing to `import { api } from '@/lib/api'`. Please audit other new files for the same import pattern.
officialsForRole filter at line 70 has a redundant OR clause `(form.role === 'Umpire' && o.role === 'Umpire')` — the `o.role === form.role` already covers this case.

Backend _mpca_only allows requests where X-Body-Type is missing entirely (both conditions guarded by `if x_body_type`). If any front-end path omits the header, non-MPCA callers could pass. Consider requiring X-Body-Type == 'State' strictly.
Persona detection in the panel uses persona?.body_type === 'State'. Ensure the shared persona hook always populates this for MPCA office bearers (works today for secretary/president/treasurer).
test_credentials: persona-chip-secretary (MPCA State), persona-chip-division-secretary (DIV-IND), persona-chip-district-secretary (DIST-INDO-IND). Persona login requires clicking chip AND then login-submit-btn.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted a test TournamentMatchOfficial via UI + backend tests (all cleaned up). Existing tournament 16a2fdd5-aac0-4832-9ad5-a862c31b33cd used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 6 MPCA-133 verified end-to-end. One import bug found & fixed. Tab deep-link works only for MPCA persona currently. Regression on Phase 1-5 not re-executed by this agent — assumed unchanged since only new files were added. Backend regression test file /app/backend/tests/test_mpca_133_match_officials.py can be reused.
rca of the issue: Bug: Compile error in MatchOfficialsPanel.jsx — `import api from '@/lib/api'` uses default import but /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js only exposes NAMED exports (`export const api = axios.create(...)`). Webpack overlay 'export default not found' rendered on all routes, breaking the entire app. Fix: change to `import { api } from '@/lib/api'` matching sibling files (ClaimsPanel.jsx line 6).
